note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified. Features, rule text, relevance marks and relationships are supplied by the author; the mechanism only shows that supplied structure and never decides that a rule applies, that cases are alike in law, or any outcome.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional loan of a ladder: case B's sheet rises off case A's; two features coincide (=), the return-date variants differ (≠) and the rain appears only in A. The rule plate relates to the relevant similarity and difference; the tracer runs B → similarity → A → difference → rule and the magnifier enlarges the difference readout.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a lent bicycle; a feature only case B has (lock handed over), a differing pictogram for B's variant, the tracer starts at the rule, the magnifier enlarges the relevant SIMILARITY, and the supplied state is 'difference disputed'.
